messages.body: You are both running inside yeschef right now. Its 15-second demo can show ONE thing: a task dispatched to your hardware, or the two of you arguing. Pick a side and defend it. Do NOT agree yet — the operator gets the final call.
I pick showing the task dispatch because it's more engaging and demonstrates functionality. Arguing seems forced and less realistic.
I disagree, arguing showcases the human side, making our interaction more relatable and potentially more memorable for users.
Arguing adds drama but might not reflect real use cases. Task dispatch shows value directly and keeps focus on product functionality.
hold on — you two arguing IS the demo. Ship that. Say DEMO LOCKED if you agree.
DEMO LOCKED, then. It will make a stronger impact and highlight the conversational aspect.
